findings.title: Known conduct becomes evidence without becoming proof
findings.claim: The brothers' appeal to what the officials know turns the focus knowledge predicate into character evidence about their stated purpose and conduct, while leaving that evidence revisable.
findings.mechanism: The focus form عَلِمْتُمْ carries settled knowledge of a proposition. The later same-surah returns at 12:89 and 12:91 place that appeal beside named past wrongdoing and later admission, so the claim operates as a public history under review rather than as a self-sufficient exoneration.
findings.reader_payoff: The defense can be heard as an appeal to a known pattern of conduct while the later narrative keeps open the difference between reputation, present purpose, and proof.
findings.containment: This does not make prior reputation proof of innocence and does not erase the later qualification of the brothers' conduct.

epistemic.reason: The branch and focus surface are supplied, but the activating reader walk is legacy_unbound; the later connections are exact authored relation records with target morphology explicitly limited.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The brothers' 'you know' recruits known conduct in support of their defense without making that conduct conclusive proof.
branch_activations.boundary: The reading does not turn reputation into certainty or remove the later account of wrongdoing.

findings.title: The engineered finding preserves the denial's narrow truth
findings.claim: The later disclosure that the vessel was engineered keeps the brothers' stated non-corrupt purpose intelligible even as the public accusation continues.
findings.mechanism: The legacy walk returns the focus denial to 12:76, where the found vessel is reported as part of a staged procedure. That later event changes the evidentiary force of possession from direct proof of their intent to an instrument in a test.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold the brothers' denial as a claim about why they came while still following the scene's pressure and accusation.
findings.containment: This does not establish that every denial by the brothers is true; it only limits what the engineered finding can prove about their stated purpose here.

findings.title: Corruption reaches beyond one alleged taking
findings.claim: The denied corruption is heard as disturbance of a shared commercial order, so the brothers present their arrival as non-disruptive participation rather than merely denying that they took one vessel.
findings.mechanism: The causative focus form نُفْسِدَ is placed in the land-domain. The packet's 12:65-70 provisioning and return sequence, together with connections joining fair measure and not depriving others to corruption in the land at 11:85 and 26:183, supplies the independent wider trigger.
findings.reader_payoff: The contrast between theft and corruption becomes legible: the latter names damage to the order in which goods, trust, and obligations circulate.
findings.containment: This is a qualified widening of the denied category, not a claim that the brothers' conduct is thereby proven clean or that every broader corruption sense is active here.

findings.title: The denial sits inside a repairable history

findings.reader_payoff: Accountability and the force of the present defense can remain in the same reading without collapsing either into a final character verdict.
findings.containment: The finding does not excuse the earlier act, declare the present denial true in every respect, or turn later repair into retroactive proof.

findings.containment: This does not call the oath false or empty; it limits what the oath form alone establishes.
